description: Repaint this arctic region as one continuous frozen polar sea seen from above. It should read as pale white pack-ice and snow broken by cracks, drifting floes, and patches of open teal water, growing snowier toward the bottom where distant mountains begin. Remove the dead-straight vertical boundary in the middle and the horizontal comb-like row of repeating ticks that cross it; there must be no straight lines and no speckled noise band anywhere. Keep exactly the same white, pale-blue and teal palette and the same pixel-art style as the surrounding ice.
